products.title: Royal Emerald Banarasi Katan Silk Saree
products.description: Woven by master weavers in Varanasi, this heritage saree features intricate floral jaal woven with real gold-tested zari threads against a rich forest emerald ground.
products.fabricCare: 100% Pure Katan Silk with Gold Zari. Dry clean only. Preserve in muslin.

products.title: Noor Chand Terracotta Organza Hand-Embroidered Saree
products.description: A sheer gossamer silhouette draped in muted terracotta earth tones with hand-scalloped floral motifs and micro-sequin embellishments.
products.fabricCare: Pure tissue organza. Delicate scalloped borders with resham and cut-dana work.

products.title: Mehrunissa Velvet Bridal Lehenga in Deep Crimson
products.description: Designed for the modern royal bride, this bespoke crimson velvet lehenga is richly embellished with traditional Mughal archways, peacocks, and floral arabesques.
products.fabricCare: Pure Silk Micro-Velvet. Handcrafted Zardozi and Dori work. Store flat in cedar chest.

products.title: Chandrakala Ivory Silk Chikankari Kurta Set with Mukaish
products.description: Impeccably detailed with 32 intricate stitches of handcrafted Lucknowi embroidery and glistening mukaish metal work.
products.fabricCare: Pure Chanderi Silk with cotton lining. Authentic GI-tagged Lucknowi Chikankari.
products.fit: Relaxed Straight Cut with Silk Palazzo

products.title: Sitara Gold Organza Anarkali Set with Tissue Dupatta
products.description: Radiate warmth in this molten gold anarkali featuring hand-done marodi embroidery and a pure tissue silk dupatta.
products.fabricCare: Metallic Silk Organza with Gota Patti lace borders.

products.title: Aura Pleated Silk Slip Dress in Midnight Obsidian
products.description: A showstopping minimalist bias-cut dress featuring a cowl neckline and sensual open cross-back strapping.
products.fabricCare: 100% Mulberry Silk (19 Momme). Hand wash cold or gentle green dry clean.

products.title: Solstice Linen Wide-Leg Co-ord Set in Sage & Cream
products.description: Effortless vacation luxury designed for sunny coastal afternoons and relaxed summer brunches.
products.fabricCare: 100% Normandy certified breathable linen.
products.fit: Relaxed tailored crop blazer and pleated palazzos

products.title: Padmavati 22K Gold Plated Kundan & Pearl Choker Necklace
products.description: Handcrafted by heritage karigars of Jaipur, featuring cascading freshwater seed pearls and radiant meenakari enamel work on the reverse.
products.fabricCare: Brass base alloy with 22K micro gold plating, uncut glass kundan, and cultured pearls.

products.title: Maharani Zari Embroidered Velvet Potli Bag
products.description: The quintessential Indian festive companion, large enough to fit an iPhone Pro Max while looking like a museum artifact.
products.fabricCare: Plush velvet with hand embroidered Dabka and mirror work.
products.fit: Dimensions: 22cm x 20cm with metallic pearl tassel cord

products.title: Royal Jodhpur Bandhgala Jacket in Raw Mulberry Silk
products.description: Commanding presence meets effortless sartorial refinement. Features a high mandarin collar, welt pockets, and hand-stitched pick stitch detailing.
products.fabricCare: Pure Mulberry Raw Silk with cupro lining. Professional dry clean only.
products.fit: Structured Tailored Bandhgala with Monogram Horn Buttons

products.title: Kashmiri Aari Embroidered Tussar Silk Kurta Set
products.description: Understated opulence for the modern Indian gentleman. Hand-embroidery inspired by the chinar leaves of the Kashmir valley.
products.fabricCare: Natural Tussar Silk with delicate aari hook embroidery along placket.

products.title: Bespoke Egyptian Giza Cotton Poplin Formal Shirt
products.description: The pinnacle of executive luxury. Crisp, silky hand-feel, non-iron finish that remains immaculate through long board meetings.
products.fabricCare: 140/2 ply Long-staple Giza Cotton. Mother-of-pearl buttons. Machine wash gentle.
products.fit: Contemporary Slim Fit with Cutaway Collar

products.title: Resort Camp-Collar Pure Linen Shirt in Sage Green
products.description: Effortlessly breezy silhouette designed for tropical sea breezes, sunset cocktails, and weekend lounging.
products.fabricCare: 100% Pre-washed European Flax Linen.
products.fit: Relaxed Boxy Fit with Cuban Collar

products.title: Tailored Italian Wool Pleated Gurkha Trousers
products.description: Inspired by mid-century military bespoke tailoring, featuring a waistband buckle closure that eliminates the need for belts.
products.fabricCare: Super 120s lightweight wool & linen blend. Handcrafted horn buckles.
products.fit: High-rise Double Pleated with Adjustable Side Tabs

products.title: Japanese 14oz Selvedge Denim in Raw Indigo
products.description: Woven on vintage shuttle looms in Okayama. Develops unique personalized honeycombs and whiskers as it ages with wear.
products.fabricCare: 100% Kurabo Mills Japanese Cotton. Sanforized. Wear often, wash cold inside out.
products.fit: Classic Straight Leg with Red-line Selvedge ID

products.title: Handcrafted Kolhapuri Mules with Cushioned Leather Insole
products.description: A contemporary reinvention of the legendary Kolhapuri chappal featuring an ergonomic memory-foam footbed for all-day wedding comfort.
products.fabricCare: Vegetable tanned genuine buffalo leather. Brass braided braid stitch.
products.fit: Standard Indian Mens Size (True to size)

products.title: Royal Heritage Chronograph with Italian Alligator Leather Strap
products.description: Meticulously engineered dial with Devanagari numerals at 12 and 6, guilloché sunburst pattern, and Swiss quartz movement.
products.fabricCare: 316L Surgical Stainless Steel case with 5 ATM water resistance.

products.title: Pure Mulberry Silk Printed Pocket Square & Cufflink Set
products.description: Inspired by Persian botanical prints preserved at the City Palace of Jaipur. Hand-rolled hems made by master artisans.
products.fabricCare: 100% Twill Silk. Enamel inlay cufflinks with swiveling T-bar.

products.title: Chanderi Silk Angrakha Kurti in Dusty Rose
products.description: Graceful overlapping front with handmade latkan tassels and intricate resham stitchwork.
products.fabricCare: Chanderi Silk with fine zari stripes. Dry clean recommended.
products.fit: Angrakha Wrap Over with Tie-up Tassels

products.title: Ajrakh Hand-Block Printed Mulberry Silk Saree
products.description: Heritage 16-step Ajrakh block printing from Kutch using natural indigo, madder root, and iron rust dyes.
products.fabricCare: Natural vegetable dyes. Gentle hand wash with cold water and mild pH detergent.

products.title: Raw Silk Nehru Waistcoat with Brass Coin Buttons
products.description: The quintessential Indian layering piece. Wear it over a crisp kurta or a formal linen shirt.
products.fabricCare: 100% Handloom Matka Silk. Brass antique finish buttons.

products.title: Organic Supima Cotton Heavyweight Crewneck T-Shirt
products.description: The ultimate luxury basic. Dense yet soft to the touch, with a thick ribbed collar that never sags.
products.fabricCare: 240 GSM 100% American Supima Cotton. Preshrunk.

products.title: Tailored Italian Linen Double-Breasted Blazer in Sand
products.description: Imbued with breezy sprezzatura. Deconstructed shoulders give a relaxed drape while maintaining sharp contours.
products.fabricCare: Irish woven flax linen with unlined butterfly back.

products.title: Little Prince Royal Brocade Sherwani Kurta Set (Boys)
products.description: Designed for young princes to celebrate in royal luxury without scratching or itching.
products.fabricCare: Soft cotton lining against skin with rich gold zari brocade exterior.
products.fit: Comfortable Kid Fit with Elasticated Dhoti Pants
